description: The answer first: one verdict sentence, then claimed, audited and the gap with 95% intervals, the evidence tier, provenance (connected, witnessed or uploaded; for witnessed data whether the customer reconciled it), judge validation, the drivers of the gap, the period, sample sizes and the data's scope. For a published vendor (by slug) or the public sample audit.

vendor.description: A published vendor's profile slug, e.g. "acme-ai-resolve-bot". Omit for the public sample audit (synthetic demo data, labelled as such).
